findings.title: Backend TLS policy targets a Service that does not exist
findings.cause: BackendTLSPolicy payments-tls targets Service payments-svc, and there is no Service payments-svc in namespace kd-gateway-backend-tls-target-missing (there is a Service payments), so the policy applies to nothing: a Gateway connects without TLS to the Service it was written for, whose pods refuse plain-text connections if they serve only TLS

evidence.command: kubectl get backendtlspolicy payments-tls -n kd-gateway-backend-tls-target-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.targetRefs}'

findings.fix: Point the policy's targetRefs at Service payments, if that is the one it was written for: a Gateway connects to it without TLS until a policy targets it.
